sealed_story_packet.headline: Asana’s coachable agents make roles, memory, and permissions visible
verified_visual_facts: An AI teammate has a visible role, approved users, administrators, skills, integrations and scoped permissions.
The teammate works through visible tasks in the existing work graph.
Task feedback can be given broadly while permanent shared-memory changes are separately governed.
Only administrators and editors commit or undo durable memory changes.
sealed_story_packet.visual_brief: A governed AI teammate operating model: a visible teammate profile connects to role, approved users and scoped access, feeds a task graph, then splits feedback into a local task path and an administrator-gated shared-memory path.
